title: The Golden Joystick Awards Ultimate Game of the Year voting is a-go, with games like Crimson Desert, The Blood of Dawnwalker, and Big Walk all on the docket
body: The Golden Joystick Awards' Ultimate Game of the Year voting is now open —celebrating its 44th consecutive year, the votes will remain open until 8 pm ET / 12 am GMT, October 30. It's a stacked roster of nominations this year—with some of our own favourites here at PC Gamer listed to take the crown. Here's an official list of the nominations: 007 First Light Big Walk CONTROL Resonant Crimson Desert Dispatch Forza Horizon 6 Phantom Blade: Zero Pokémon Pokopia PRAGMATA Resident Evil Requiem STAR WARS: Galactic Racer The Blood of Dawnwalker Speaking personally, it's a tough one for me to pick— Crimson Desert is maybe the most technically impressive in terms of scope, releasing with not only a billion systems but also receiving massive updates over the course of the year. So many, in fact, I'm sort of wondering when anyone else at Pearl Abyss is gonna take a break. Star Wars: Galactic Racer has devoured hours of my time, and I've been playing it so much I've developed a new callus on my thumb, whereas Dispatch was a short-but-sweet romp and one of my favourite superhero stories in recent memory.
